description: This Java class 'HeaderTranslator' provides utilities for translating headers between external sources and internal representations within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for creating instances with specific header definitions, filtering headers, and converting between external headers and Ditto headers, with special handling for known headers and performance optimizations.

classes.name: HeaderTranslator
classes.description: Utility class for translating headers between external sources and internal Ditto headers, with filtering and merging capabilities.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Creates a HeaderTranslator with no header definitions.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a HeaderTranslator from arrays of header definitions, merging duplicates with special handling for 'timeout'.

methods.name: fromExternalHeaders
methods.description: Converts external headers map to internal headers, filtering based on header definitions.

methods.name: toExternalHeaders
methods.description: Converts DittoHeaders to external headers map.

methods.name: retainKnownHeaders
methods.description: Filters external headers to retain only those known to this translator.

methods.name: toExternalAndRetainKnownHeaders
methods.description: Converts DittoHeaders to external headers, filtering out unknown headers.

methods.name: forgetHeaderKeys
methods.description: Returns a new HeaderTranslator without certain header keys (deprecated).
